# Katoa

> Zero-fee creator platform on Bitcoin — wishlists, Lightning support, creators keep 100%.
> Non-custodial. Open source (MIT). Part of the Give A Bit family.
> Keep All That's Owed Always.

[Katoa](https://katoa.org)

Public creator profiles: `/u/:username`. Wishlists: `/wishlist/:slug`.
`/pitch` exists but is **noindex** — do not treat it as a search landing.

## Notes for agents
- Brand: Keep All That's Owed Always. 0% PLATFORM fees forever. Bitcoin Lightning. Nostr optional. 195+ countries. MIT. Give A Bit. Safe Harbour.
- Visual: night-jewel (deep plum #12081c / ember #080510). Accent violet #a78bfa product, bitcoin orange money, neon cyan interactive. Not beige, not pure #000.
- Map: MapLibre + OpenFreeMap (not Leaflet).
- Languages: en es pt fr de ja zh. No Swahili.
- Pulse/Protocol widgets removed 2026-07-06. Footer/nav BTC price strip remains.
- OF-parity likes/comments/PPV/subscribe are **client-local seams** until Lightning webhook. Do not invent live invoices.
- Platform fee: 0%. Settlement: Bitcoin / Lightning to creator-controlled destinations (non-custodial).
- Sample/demo catalog content is labeled Demo when not a live creator account.
- Metrics: public/metrics.json is a **labeled SAMPLE** (11 creators, `demo: true`). Never "thousands of creators."
- Keywords: zero fee creator platform bitcoin; bitcoin lightning wishlist; nostr creator support; keep 100% creator earnings; non-custodial lightning tips.
- Avoid: donation widget, OnlyFans alternative (as public SEO), crypto/web3.
- Source: https://github.com/kitsboy/katoa
